title: {session}-hypothesis.json
description: Step 3 output. Persists original_prompt verbatim plus hypothesis, complexity_hint, and structured anti-bias alternatives. Consumed by 6.b shard, 8 verify error-surfacing, p1.6/p2.7 inline summary, reflectors. See apex-core.md step 3.

alternatives.description: 1-3 narrower/broader scope readings; the structured anti-bias check Step 3 cannot skip.

discovered_paths.description: Optional. Repo-relative file paths the orchestrator validated during step-3 inline exploration (Glob/Grep/Read on conceptual prompts where the user named no file paths). Consumed by 6.a enumerate-scout as additional seed_paths (drives static-imports / framework / lsp expansion the same way prompt-explicit paths do) AND by 6.a zero-layer dispatch as autonomous fallback scope - when non-empty, zero-layer routes through zero-layer-extract.sh without an AskUserQuestion. Empty / absent when the prompt itself names paths (regex extraction covers them) or when step-3 did no exploration.
